supported_claims: Under the listed frozen protocols, target-label adaptation can improve source-only performance in some domain-direction, architecture, and budget cells.
No tested structured selection rule has a stable advantage over the specified random and original-image controls across the tested conditions.
Original-image grouping and geographic/spatial proxies must be separated analytically because they do not yield interchangeable selections or effects.
The ISPRS experiment was evaluated with receipt-level holdout separation and one-time blind scoring.
unsupported_claims: A new joint selector is universally effective or superior.
The acquisition-only Cai/RIPU adaptations are faithful reproductions of their complete original methods.
The study is ready for a TGRS method-effectiveness submission.
The results establish annotation-time savings, SOTA performance, or generalization to arbitrary regions.
limitations: The v2 audits verify saved records, not an independent full retraining.
The ISPRS RIPU implementation is an acquisition-only, label-blind adaptation rather than a full original-method reproduction.
The representative ISPRS replay is one receipt; CUDA loss uses warn-only deterministic handling.
RC2ADA equations/text remain unresolved and author code was not verified.
The heterogeneous OEM, LoveDA, v4f, and ISPRS protocols must not be pooled into a single effect size.
